description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Poll a reference image started by upload_video_reference_image (removeBackground) or generate_video_reference_image every few seconds until status is 'completed' (use `path` as referenceImagePath) or 'failed' (credits are returned automatically).

referenceRenderId.description: referenceRenderId from the upload or generate tool.

name: get_video_reference_image_status
title: Check a reference image
